topic: How a multi-branch operation manages payroll for four locations from one screen
format: Open with a SmartPRO Hub product capability, then show the real-world business outcome it enables
post:
A retail group in Oman was running payroll across four branches — Muscat, Sohar, Salalah, and Sur — with a separate spreadsheet for each location.

Every month: four files, four rounds of manual calculations, four chances to botch a WPS submission.

They moved to SmartPRO Hub and pulled all four branches into a single payroll dashboard.

One screen. One run. One WPS file sent directly to the bank — no spreadsheet handoffs, no back-and-forth with finance, no scrambling for corrections the night before the deadline.

Their HR manager went from three days on payroll to under two hours.

We built this because multi-branch operations in Oman don't struggle with spreadsheets — they struggle with coordination. When each location runs its own process, month-end becomes four separate emergencies instead of one clean close.

One platform covers all branches: SPF contributions, Ministry of Labour filings, and Omanization ratios in the same place, not scattered across tabs someone has to manually reconcile.

If your payroll process still depends on someone remembering to merge four files before payday, that's the first thing worth fixing.
